title: garcinia pungens
intro: Garcinia pungens, commonly known as the Malabar tamarind, is a plant species belonging to the family Clusiaceae. The Malabar tamarind is known for its potential health benefits, including weight loss, improved digestion, and reduced inflammation. Its therapeutic actions include acting as an appetite suppressant, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory agent, which may contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Garcinia pungens include garcinol, isogarcinol, and other flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
